title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named SouthSide destinations along Third Street, Fourth Street, New Street, and Broadway, each paired with one practical reason to leave campus.

cards.title: Choose an Artisanal Donut
cards.subtitle: East Fourth Street corridor · 3 E 4th St.
cards.notes: Walk the Fourth Street corridor for handmade artisanal donuts, then compare the shop’s coffee and tea options while ordering.
cards.short_summary: A Fourth Street stop centered on handmade donuts.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh lists Donerds Donuts at 3 E 4th St. as an off-campus SouthSide shop serving handmade artisanal donuts, coffee, and tea.
cards.source_title: Restaurants near Lehigh University | Lehigh University
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant; a purchase is required. Check the linked business website for current operating hours before visiting.
